Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You flinch into a scatter of leaves and emerge a few paces from where the blow found you.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, after a visible attack resolves against you.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Vanish into a swirl of leaves and reappear in a visible free square within 2 squares. No opaque barrier may separate the squares. This teleport does not provoke.
